name: Snowflake MCP (PAT)
description: Dynamically discovers and exposes the tools of one or more Snowflake Cortex Agents MCP servers (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP), authenticated with Programmatic Access Tokens (PAT) — no OAuth flow, so "Refresh tools" works without connecting. All MCP servers share a single Snowflake account; the `servers[]` array lists the individual MCP endpoints (database/schema/mcp_server), each using its own `pat` or the account-wide `snowflakePat`. Every user shares the PAT owner's Snowflake identity and role. For per-user OAuth, use the `snowflake` plugin.
author: AI Playground

snowflakeBaseUrl.title: Snowflake Account URL
snowflakeBaseUrl.description: Base URL of your Snowflake account, e.g. https://xy12345.snowflakecomputing.com

snowflakePat.title: Programmatic Access Token (PAT)
snowflakePat.description: Account-wide Snowflake PAT used by every server without its own `pat`. All users share the PAT owner's identity and role.

servers.title: MCP Servers
servers.description: List of Snowflake managed MCP servers to expose. Each one needs a PAT (its own `pat` or the account-wide one above).

id.title: Server ID
id.description: Unique identifier used by tools to target this server (lowercase, e.g. 'analytics_cortex').

mcpServerPath.title: MCP Server Path
mcpServerPath.description: Path of the managed MCP server, e.g. /api/v2/databases/MY_DB/schemas/MY_SCHEMA/mcp-servers/MY_MCP

pat.title: Programmatic Access Token (PAT)
pat.description: Snowflake PAT for this server; overrides the account-wide `snowflakePat`.

timeoutSeconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time for a tool call to this server.
